We don't have Yang model for NEIGH table.

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Run build pipeline for below PR:
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/10963
2. Check build log:
sonic_yang(6):Note: Below table(s) have no YANG models: TUNNEL, FG_NHG_MEMBER, FG_NHG, NEIGH

#### Describe the results you received:
sonic-config-engine unit test failed.

#### Describe the results you expected:
sonic-config-engine unit test should pass.

linkedPullRequests.title: [yang] add NEIGH yang model
linkedPullRequests.author: Ndancejic
linkedPullRequests.body:
#### Why I did it
Yang model for NEIGH table was missing
Fixed https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/13971

#### How I did it
added sonic-neigh.yang model

#### How to verify it
make buildimage

comments.author: isabelmsft
comments.body:
I suspect generic_config_updater unit test failures are related to libyang backlink issue tracked here: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/9312 

See @wen587 comment on previous PR with similar unit test failure: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/12749#issuecomment-1354068566

comments.author: wen587
comments.body: Hi @Ndancejic   you may need to comment out vlan import. As it will break libyang backlinks. Issue can be tracked here: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/9312
